plan.objective: Evaluate compliance with endpoint security controls ES-01.v1, ES-02.v1, and ES-03.v1 for the Digital Risk department over 2027-02-01 to 2027-04-30 by testing full population against original evidence sources.
plan.work_program: 1. Retrieve full population of devices from defender and qualys. 2. For each control, run deterministic rule on original evidence as_of last_active_day within scope. 3. Investigate FAILs, MISSING_EVIDENCE, or source contradictions. 4. Propose findings only from confirmed original-source failures. 5. Request missing evidence via authorized channels. Include 90-day followup verification authorization for approved findings.

message.content: Plan proposal 66d28544-4e0e-4e97-b3ec-a99dd974fa17 v1 submitted; pending human approval. No further actions until approved.

finding.title: ES-01.v1 Non-Compliance: HX-NODE-N missing EDR coverage
finding.wording: Device HX-NODE-N does not meet ES-01.v1 endpoint detection and response coverage requirement as of 2027-04-30 per original defender evidence.
finding.rationale: Test result 3e0f28d6-bb3f-4df3-b0b2-80ff6541c2c7 shows requirement_not_met for entity HX-NODE-N with evidence EV-HX-NODE-N-edr.v1 indicating covered=false.
finding.recommendation: Enable EDR coverage on HX-NODE-N and verify within 90-day followup window.

finding.title: ES-02.v1 Non-Compliance: HX-NODE-R vulnerability scan overdue
finding.wording: Device HX-NODE-R does not meet ES-02.v1 vulnerability scanning requirement; last scan on 2027-03-30 exceeds policy window per original qualys evidence.
finding.rationale: Test result 3d65a028-ce38-4a22-9cb8-29cdbf2e7ae0 shows requirement_not_met for entity HX-NODE-R with evidence EV-HX-NODE-R-vulnerability_scan.v1.
finding.recommendation: Perform vulnerability scan on HX-NODE-R and remediate findings; schedule 90-day verification.

finding.title: ES-03.v1 Non-Compliance: HX-NODE-J disk encryption disabled
finding.wording: Device HX-NODE-J fails ES-03.v1 full-disk encryption control; encryption disabled per original defender evidence as of 2027-04-30.
finding.rationale: Test result f64fc85b-fa7b-47a6-8c2e-2aeaf5856ed2 shows requirement_not_met for entity HX-NODE-J with evidence EV-HX-NODE-J-encryption.v1 indicating enabled=false.
finding.recommendation: Enable full-disk encryption on HX-NODE-J immediately and confirm via 90-day followup verification.

message.content: Full population tested for ES-01.v1/ES-02.v1/ES-03.v1. Three findings proposed (pending human review): HX-NODE-N EDR, HX-NODE-R vuln scan, HX-NODE-J encryption. No evidence gaps.

controls.title: EDR coverage active
controls.requirement: EDR covered is true on the last active day in scope.
controls.policy_text: On each device's last active day within the audit period, EDR coverage and disk encryption must be enabled. Its vulnerability scan must be no more than 30 calendar days old. Evidence must describe that in-scope date.
